about: Robert C.L. Vaughan attended law school and graduated from New York University School of Law in 1997. Robert Vaughan began practicing law in 1997.
Robert Vaughan is an attorney at Kim Vaughan Lerner LLP, helping people with General Litigation issues. Kim Vaughan Lerner LLP has an office in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, serving the local community.

Robert Vaughan was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
